blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Palawan is calling on the National Power Corporation (Napocor) and the Palawan Electric Cooperative (Paleco) to take over power facilities in Dumaran and Barangay Manamoc in Cuyo town. It made the call because PowerSource Philippines, Inc. (PSPI) is moving to cease operations, according to posts from the official social media page of the Palawan Sangguniang Panlalawigan. Around 1,000 households in the island barangay of Manamoc have already endured intermittent power outages even before PSPI’s scheduled shutdown on November 22, said Palawan Board Member Christopher Jake Tan.
